description: Theories and Skill Tiers, from RULES.md (Skills, Traits, and Theories). A Theory at theoryCompletePercent can become a T1 Skill at Lv1. A Skill of a Tier tiers up by combining combineCount related items, listed per current Tier in tierUpSources. The Arbiter decides which items are related.

1.note: T1 to T2: 5 related Theories at 100%

2.note: T2 to T3: 5 related T1 Skills

3.note: T3 to T4: 5 related T2 Skills

4.note: T4 to T5: 5 related T3 Skills
